tools.name: clean_page
tools.description: Fetches a URL and returns clean, structured, agent-optimized content: readable markdown, plain text, metadata (author/date/site/word count), extracted links and images, an optional structured facts array, and a 0-100 quality score. Handles common failure modes (paywalls, bot-walls, empty JS shells)

tools.name: health
tools.description: Free. Returns service status, version, and uptime signal. Use to check the service is reachable before paying for anything.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Free. Returns the full list of tools this server offers, including which are paid, their prices, and their input schemas — so an agent can decide what to call before spending anything.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Returns current pricing, accepted payment network/asset, and the x402 payment flow details for paid tools.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "clean_page" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
